---
title: "lowpoly-pdf-to-svg"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/edges.R")
edges <- if (file.exists("generated/edges.csv")) read_edges("generated/edges.csv")
sheets <- read_csv("generated/sheets.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

Turns low poly papercraft PDF templates into one Inkscape SVG, ready for review and Cricut Design Space. Every piece becomes a group with its cut outline, score lines for the folds and pen-drawn edge numbers, tagged with its cardstock colour.

```bash
make install
make            # data/bowser.pdf -> output/bowser/bowser.svg
```

The first template is the Bowser mask. The [Results](sheets.qmd) pages show each PDF page next to the traced SVG, and whether the printed edge numbers pair up into [glue edges](glue-pairs.qmd) of the same length.

## The model

The Bowser papercraft mask is by [Sweets The Cat](https://sweetsthecat.itch.io/) (also credited as Papercraft Cat), made as a Halloween project and free for personal use. This repository does not include or redistribute the PDF; check the creator's current terms before sharing derived files. A community mirror is on [Paperzone VN](https://paperzonevn.com/bowser-mask.t13095/).

## Where it stands

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (file.exists("generated/summary.md")) {
  # The pipeline's summary: its first paragraph here; the tables are drawn below from the CSV.
  lines <- readLines("generated/summary.md")
  body <- lines[!str_starts(lines, "#")]
  first <- cumsum(body == "" & lag(body != "", default = FALSE))
  cat(body[first == min(first[body != ""])], sep = "\n")
} else if (!is.null(edges)) {
  n <- count(edges, verdict) |> deframe()
  cat(sprintf("%d sheets, %d printed edge numbers: **%d matching**, **%d need work**.\n",
              nrow(sheets), nrow(edges), n[["matching"]], n[["needs work"]]))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("%d sheets converted. The edge-number check has not been run yet.\n", nrow(sheets)))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-status
#| fig-cap: "Printed edge numbers by check result. Only *ok* means both edges were found and their lengths agree."
#| fig-height: 3.2
if (!is.null(edges)) {
  edges |>
    count(status, verdict) |>
    ggplot(aes(n, fct_rev(status), fill = verdict)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(matching = "#1a9e8f", `needs work` = "#d61f69")) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    labs(x = "edge numbers", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sheets
#| tbl-cap: "Edge numbers per sheet, worst first."
if (!is.null(edges)) {
  sheets |>
    transmute(Page = sprintf("%02d", page), Cardstock = label, Matching = matching, `Needs work` = `needs work`,
              `Share ok` = scales::percent(matching / (matching + `needs work`), accuracy = 1)) |>
    arrange(desc(`Needs work` / (Matching + `Needs work`))) |>
    knitr::kable(align = "llrrr")
}
```
